codeReview.description: -1 for something that must change before it lands, 1 if it looks good, 0 for no vote.

comments.description: New inline comments on this patch set, and replies to earlier threads; at most 100 in all.

path.description: The file's path in the repository. For a reply, the parent comment's path.

line.description: For a new comment, the line in this patch set's version of the file, or null for the whole file. For a reply, the parent comment's line.

message.description: The comment, in Markdown, at most 8,000 characters.

inReplyTo.description: For a reply, the id of the comment it answers; null for a new comment.

patchSet.description: For a reply, the parent comment's patch set; null for a new comment, which goes on this patch set.

resolved.description: true if the thread needs nothing more, false if it still needs action, null to leave it as it is.
